data.notes: No February 2027 contemporary music events or club-party calendars in Saint-Barthélemy were sufficiently confirmed on primary/reputable event sources yet; the island’s official carnival program remains pending.

events.title: Saint-Barth Carnival 2027: Levé en pyjama, Mardi Gras Parade & Vaval Burning
events.summary: Carnival week centers on Gustavia street celebrations: the informal Levé en pyjama on February 8, the Mardi Gras parade on February 9, and the Vaval burning procession to Shell Beach on February 10, with Caribbean-music float culture and after-parade street partying.

events.title: ASCCO Cho Douvan at the Saint-Barth Mardi Gras Parade
events.summary: Local cultural association ASCCO confirms its Cho Douvan group will parade in Gustavia for Mardi Gras 2027, with costumes, choreography, float preparation and music kept under wraps until carnival day.

events.title: St Barth Burgundy Week Nikki Beach Party
events.summary: St Barth Burgundy Week closes with a Nikki Beach Party on Valentine’s Sunday, a confirmed beach-club day party framed as a festive winemaker gathering at Saint-Jean.

events.title: La Paulée / St Barth Burgundy Week After Party at Le Ti St Barth
events.summary: The Burgundy Week gala at Eden Rock moves into a late-night after party at Le Ti St Barth from midnight, giving the wine-week crowd a confirmed high-season club/cabaret stop.
